findings.statement: The sum of all non-null invoice amounts in the invoices table equals 202682.05.
findings.method: SQL aggregation with SUM after cleaning string values by removing '$' and ',' characters
findings.code:
SELECT 
    SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(amount, '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE)) as total_amount
FROM invoices
WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != ''

data_quality_notes: 4 null values in the amount column (5% of rows)
Amounts stored as strings with '$' and ',' formatting requiring cleaning before numeric operations
assumptions: All non-null amounts are valid invoice amounts to be summed
The currency unit is consistent across all records (implied by the '$' prefix)
limitations: 4 missing amount values excluded from total calculation
String-based amount column requires parsing before numeric operations, which may introduce rounding errors if not handled carefully
